boundary: A normal packaged App plus actual same-session second BrowserWindow, same app file URL, no preload/node integration/IPC permission and no auth replacement. Programmatic URL transfer and malicious fetches are the explicit security inputs; project preparation public API, opening/closing/reopening/navigation actual pointer UI. Original resource IPC is passively observed/delegated/restored. No clipboard, Store/editor/DOM-value injection, fabricated responses, external service/App, daily credentials, model or live Codex.
